title: The Why the Cat Gets the High Chair
youtube_title: The Why the Cat Gets the High Chair | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A story belongs to the person still speaking it.
summary: At a library window seat, the ferryman begins to tell Uma about why the cat's blanket goes on the high chair. Uma wants to interrupt with bigger news, but listens all the way to the last sentence, asks one real question, and only then shares something small of their own.
